title: useEffect runs twice in development with React Strict Mode
symptoms: Network requests fire twice on mount in dev
cause: React 18+ Strict Mode intentionally double-invokes certain lifecycles in development to surface missing cleanup.
solution: Make effects idempotent: return a cleanup that aborts fetch/cancels subscriptions. Do not disable Strict Mode just to hide the symptom.
workaround: Confirm production build runs once; use AbortController in effects.
